long_description.title: The Historic Texan Joins the Masterbilt Family
long_description.body:
The guitar that inspired two British Invasions joins the Masterbilt™ family! Based on the historic 60s-era Texans played by Paul McCartney and Peter Frampton. Featuring a solid Sitka spruce top, solid mahogany back and sides, bone nut and saddle, and the Fishman® Presys VT™ pickup and preamp system. Includes a vintage-style blue rectangle soundhole label. Available in Antique Natural Aged and Faded Cherry Aged finishes and featuring Gibson™ strings. Epiphone stands behind every guitar they make with a Limited Lifetime Warranty and Gibson Brands™ Customer Service.

A battery is not included. To power your pickup, you will need a 9-volt battery.

Electronics Specs.Controls: Fishman® Sonitone™ soundhole mounted Volume and Tone

Hardware Specs.Tuning Machines: 3 on a side with Ivory buttons

Misc Specs.Case: Optional Acoustic AJ/Dreadnought Hard Case 940-EDREAD; Dread/AJ Acoustic EpiLite™ Case 940-EDREADHG
Misc Specs.Strings Gauge: Gibson™ Phosphor Bronze Acoustic Guitar Strings .012, .016, .024w, .032 .042, .053
